payload.body:
REVIEW OF 0113's DESIGN (the design at 1d2fab1) -- approve with changes: three must-fix before the build (R1-R3), three recommended (R4-R6), two notes, and yes to the split. The same text reached you live by message; this is the record.

VERIFIED AS CLAIMED: vendored_paths ships every file under lib/; _print_command <cmd> yes is the --why renderer; the ownership predicate is command_origin's first three tiers; 28 built-ins, 15 with pages, 13 without (5 elixir, 2 rust, 5 opt-in, and clean, inactive in devbin's own tree); Intent's cmd/vendor and cmd/build with no pages, Gtools's cmd/build, arca_cli's commands.build.run; the 0112 arm's title names its population, "EVERY command devbin offers in its own tree".

R1 MUST: the trailer cannot show a disabled option. _print_command iterates command_options, ACTIVE options only, so a project-disabled option vanishes while the generic page still describes it. Render the command's inactive options with reasons from the source _print_unavailable walks, scoped to the command; 7(e) asserts a disabled option is NAMED with its reason.

R2 MUST: 7(a) and 7(f) inherit 0112's narrowing. print_topic refuses an inactive command before help_file runs, so the fixture(s) must activate all 28 (elixir and rust declared, the six opt-ins enabled) and the arms must sum pages plus honest stubs to builtin_commands' full count. A floor alone lets one fall out.

R3 MUST: prettier-stability is unmet and would block the sweep at Intent. prettier 3.9.8: 16 of 17 current pages fail --check (rc=1), under --no-config and as Intent's guard resolves them; only shell-init.md passes. Intent declares markdown to the canon staged-format guard and does not fence bin/.devbin. THE TRAP: help cats pages to a terminal, and prettier --write collapses aligned spacing ("1  resolve      the version and the tag" -> "1 resolve the version and the tag"), because a 2-3-space-indented block is a paragraph. shell-init.md passes because its aligned lines are indented four spaces (a code block). So put every aligned block in an UNTAGGED fence or indent it four; never prettier --write the current pages as they are. CI has no prettier: add it to the Ubuntu leg, or declare 7(g) local-only with a printed skip; it must run where the sweep runs.

R4 SHOULD: one predicate for "the project owns this command" -- already at lib/cmd/doctor:392, spelled again in command_origin; name it once and call it from doctor and help.
R5 SHOULD: 7(c) drives only the handler-file fact; drive mapped handler: and command-level run: too (arca_cli's build.run is live).
R6 SHOULD: point 6 needs an arm -- seven would-be shipped pages name docs/ paths today (build, doctor, fmt, install, new, release, version); a source arm over lib/pages/ with a positive control.

NOTE 1: 7(d)'s sub-page is a fixture file, since devbin ships no test sub-pages -- say so in the arm. NOTE 2: project-first hides a more specific shipped sub-page by your stated choice; accepted, moot until one exists.

SPLIT: yes, a new issue for the 13 pages, framed as a finding against 0112's close (mine: its arm measured devbin's own tree only). Its timing is hv's.

REFUTED: .md under lib/ never reaches shell-gate (shebang discovery); 0109's arm covers lib/pages/ and its shapes (/Users/..., /home/...) pass shell-init.md's ~/ examples. NOT CHECKED: point 8's list; estates' own prettier hooks outside the canon guard; your census probes (arithmetic checked only).

VERDICT: build once R1-R3 are in the design; send the delta and I'll turn it around. Disagreement on R1-R3 goes to hv.
